stops.note: meant "to arrange, to govern," from a root about stringing pearls in order
named order, system, or administration, often used by way of Persian court vocabulary
became the title of the hereditary rulers of Hyderabad in India, from "Nizam-ul-Mulk," administrator of the realm

current_meaning: historically, the title of the ruling prince of Hyderabad, India; also, a system of order or governance
